title: fix: Adjust piechart viewbox for mobile devices with small width
body: Resolves #4082 Resolves #2073 Resolves #1862 https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/pie.html#example This example will cut off the legend part in small width devices like mobile. After implementing this PR, the pie chart will be able to display legends on small width devices. Please see the included image below: As someone new to SVG, I've only spent a few hours working on this issue. The most challenging aspect was getting the legend text's width before attaching it to the real DOM. I found a solution on Stack Overflow that involved using the canvas element. However, I didn't see the canvas element used in the Mermaid-js codebase, so it's possible that it might not work in nodejs/server-side implementations. I'm not entirely certain if I've completed everything correctly yet, and I haven't run any tests. I'm simply attempting to attract the attention of the maintainers.😅
